paper_metadata.title: Effects of Nb Addition on Glass-Forming Ability, Thermal Stability and Mechanical Properties of Ti-Based Bulk Metallic Glasses

The master alloy ingots with a nominal composition of (Ti40Zr25Cu9Ni8Be18)100-xNbx with x=0, 1, 3, 4 and 5 at% were prepared by arc melting the mixture of pure ( 99.9%) Ti, Zr, Ni, Cu, Be and Nb metals under a high purity argon atmosphere.
Fully glassy cylindrical rods with a diameter of 6 mm and the composition of (Ti40Zr25Cu9Ni8Be18)100-xNbx ( x=0, 1, 3, 4, 5 at%) were prepared by copper mould casting.
